pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: join ANC visits and livelihoods by district and year, 2023 ANC and employment rates side by side
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district

CREATE TABLE "livelihoods" (

[User Question]
join ANC visits and livelihoods by district and year, 2023 ANC and employment rates side by side
```sql

```sql
SELECT
    a.district,
    a.year,
    (a.anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0)) AS anc_rate,
    (l.employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(l.completed_training, 0)) AS employment_rate
FROM anc_visits AS a
JOIN livelihoods AS l
  ON a.district = l.district
 AND a.year = l.year
WHERE a.year = 2023;
```
